0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Annine is beside herself with worry for her missing brothers.

49.original: My two brothers set out for Mount Biran Mines to see if there's anything worth salvaging, but they've been gone an awfully long time.

50.original: Would you be able to go and look for them? I'd go myself, but I hear the place is crawling with all sorts of nasty creatures, and fighting's not my forte. I don't expect you to do it for free, of course.

51.original: One of them is a bit of a big lad, and the other is also quite big, but slightly less so. I'm sure you'll know them when you see them.

53.original: She was bloody right when she said it was dangerous here.

54.original: We ran into a pack of coyotes, and we were separated when we tried to outrun them.

55.original: I got away but I don't know what's happened to my brother.

56.original: Hopefully, he found somewhere to hide. Will you help me look for him?

57.original: I'll join you in the search once I've caught my breath. I don't think I've ever run so fast in my life!

58.original: Annine sent you to find us? Thanks, stranger. I'd better go and see if my brother is all right.

59.original: I was afraid we'd never get out of here alive!

60.original: I never thought I'd be so happy to see him!

61.original: Now that we've got reinforcements, we should be able to carry on where we left off. It'll be a lot easier with someone to cover our backs.

62.original: Hold on now, <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> didn't come here for that.

63.original: Before we get ahead of ourselves, let me give you this. It's the least we can offer you for coming to our rescue.
